$comment: Anti-reimplementation ratchet baseline (ADR-0022). Count of apps/api source files importing raw infrastructure drivers (pg, ws, ioredis) or hosting an HTTP server (createServer). ffmpeg-static/ffprobe-static are sanctioned binary-path providers injected into the framework MediaProcessor (slice 4) and @aws-sdk is loaded lazily by the framework S3 driver (ADR-0023), so neither is counted. TARGET REACHED: 0 as of slice 6 (realtime → @streetjs/realtime; the ws hub + ioredis bus were retired). The product hand-rolls no reusable infrastructure; every runtime concern is consumed from the published StreetJS framework (streetjs, @streetjs/*). NEVER raise it.
